post_evaluation.idea_description: A minimal, intentionally trivial example repository published by GitHub itself and used to teach first-time users the basic fork -> clone -> edit -> push workflow, distinct from any real application code -- the content is deliberately a placeholder greeting or fork-prompt, not functional software.
post_evaluation.ranking_rationale: No claim had both an independently-verified timestamp and a substantive match above threshold. Pooled stake is refunded to every claimant.
